acceptanceCriteria: Workspace and all trilingual release/version documents identify v0.2.50; failed v0.2.49 tag remains immutable history.
Source, package, release-policy, SBOM, checksum, and post-release gates run without source or workspace-binary fallback.
Only a new immutable public v0.2.50 tag and its downloaded artifacts are used for installation and adopter acceptance.
Release and adopter evidence bind repository identity, runtime version/digest, tag, archive/binary checksums, SBOM, and cleanup manifests.
After reviewed merge and release acceptance, finalization/close receipts and tri-lingual parity are synchronized; object repositories are not modified.
goal: 从已关闭、干净、审查合并的 main 生成可公开安装的 v0.2.50，并用公开制品完成 adopter 验收。
intent: 在保留失败的 v0.2.49 immutable tag 的前提下，发布并验收 v0.2.50 Runtime。
